Hi Sara —

Hope you had a smooth quarter close. Our records show ClearVista's Annual plan is up for renewal in late October, and I wanted to surface two items we discussed on the last call so we can lock terms early:

1) APAC edge onboarding: you mentioned a pilot in Singapore for Q1 2027 to reduce latency for your clinician app. We can provision a staged APAC edge with regional KV caching and optional customer-owned VPC ingress.

2) EU cross-region failover: requirements from your InfoSec team around in-region residency during normal operations and an explicit cross-region failover path for DR. We have a standard SLA amendment that codifies residency with a managed failover playbook.

Commercial ask: to cover the APAC capacity increase and SLA amendment we usually align on a 12–36 month committed capex/commitment with a tiered discount. I attached a draft proposal and the SLA amendment for your procurement review.

Proposed next steps:
- Review attachments (proposal + SLA draft) — I can walk procurement through line items on a sync.
- Quick technical sync with Marcus to confirm target p50/p95 latency and cache sizing.
- If procurement is happy, target an addendum to the current agreement by Oct 20 so we can schedule capacity build for Jan rollout.

Open questions for you:
- Does procurement need a dedicated SOC2/ISO artefact package (we can push a package link)?
- Do you want the APAC edge in Singapore or Sydney to start?

Thanks — happy to hop on a call this week.

Best,
Karthik
